slots.1:hubstaff:
Facilitator’s Notes: During Day 1’s Setting of Expectations, the facilitator must explain this daily HS To-Do process.

Make sure to:

  • Show trainees how to follow the To-Do templates correctly.
  • Remind them daily not to miss this routine.
  • Explain the purpose: to help the audit team review work easily and to keep clear records of what was completed each day.
  • Send the necessary reminders and instructions in the training GC, depending on which instructions apply for that day.

Shadowing Sessions: For Shadowing activities, the facilitator must instruct trainees to add the following in their HS To-Do:

  • To-Do: Shadowing [Type of role or process the trainees are shadowing] (VA’s Name)
    • Example: Shadowing Intake Specialist Role/ Insurance Communication Role/ Provider Communication Role/ Lien Negotiator Role (Arlene/ Edward/ Vince/ Allesa/ Mario)

Be sure to clearly prompt the trainees each time a shadowing session is scheduled so they know exactly what to input.
